terra.problem: The city-wide uproar is a detail from outside this passage and needs a reference such as Acts 19:29.
The claim that baptizing comes up a lot in Acts needs a reference outside this passage.
The claim that storms appear elsewhere in Acts needs a reference.
The claim that the Bible has several feasts needs a reference outside this passage.
The text does not say that all the men were at the gathering or establish that Paul was not waiting for anyone. It gives his planned departure as the reason he kept speaking.
The punchline about chairs is hard to understand, and saying “Lesson learned” treats Eutychus’s dangerous fall like a lesson at his expense.
The passage does not say that nobody was sent home. It says Paul continued speaking until daybreak.
“Sadness gave way to relief” presents the people’s earlier sadness as fact, but the passage does not state it.
